name: Original City Boulevard Road Markings
source: Original project geometry; proportions informed by public road engineering drawings. Scene artwork, not an engineering compliance certification.
axes: glTF Y up; UE (X,Y,Z)=(glTF x,z,y)*100, exactly once.

trafficSource.mapping: X=-Direction*(2.2+3*Lane); glTF dZ/dt=Direction. East positive-X traffic moves toward -Z; west negative-X traffic moves toward +Z.
trafficSource.behavior: Existing continuous animated traffic is unchanged; painted crossing controls do not add a signal or stopping simulation.

geometryChecks.method: Downward raycasts against final merged geometry plus all actual vertex bounds/heights and traffic-source direction checks.

tests.exceptions: Whole dashes omitted around crosswalks and stop bars.
